text: UNSEEN DEPARTURE: JD Vance Heads to Milan for Winter Olympics Opening | DRM News | AC1ZU.S. Vice President JD Vance, accompanied by his wife Usha Vance and their children, departed Washington on Wednesday night to attend the opening ceremony of the Milano Cortina Winter Olympic Games. The Vice President was seen boarding Air Force Two at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland before traveling to Milan. His visit comes amid heightened security measures and political tensions, with the presence of U.S. Immigration and Border Patrol agents drawing criticism and protests in Italy. ICE’s Homeland Security Investigations division will support U.S. diplomatic security during the Games, a move that has sparked backlash from Italian politicians and the public. Despite assurances that such deployments are standard, the issue has added controversy to the U.S. delegation’s presence.
